notes: North is up. Printed names: 'E. McMILLAN', 'AUBURN AV.', 'PARIS' (written Paris Street), 'KINSEY AV.', 'HOLLISTER ST.', 'McCORMICK PL.', 'WELLINGTON PL.', 'HELEN (NOT OPEN)' (written Helen Street). McMillan is 60' here (east of Auburn); it is 50' west of Auburn on sheet 191. Auburn/McMillan is the same junction as on sheet 191; Auburn continues north of McMillan as an unlabelled diagonal off the top-left corner, and McMillan continues west off the left edge, so recorded as a cross. Kinsey Avenue is 33' between Auburn and Paris; east of Paris it is 50' (second 50' label at x~3280) and continues straight east onto 193. Paris ends at Kinsey (no Paris south of Kinsey). Hollister and Wellington Place come in from the west (sheet 190/191 side) and end at Auburn. McCormick Place starts at Auburn and runs east off the right edge (39'6" printed). Helen is on a paste-over: it runs from its west end at x~2126 east off the right edge; an unlabelled 43'-wide street (4" water pipe) runs south from Helen at x~2314-2465 off the bottom toward sheet 183 - named 'Auburn Crest Avenue' from the key map (vertical 'AUBURN CREST AV.' with a boxed old name just south of Helen); please confirm against sheet 183. No alleys.
